title: The SuffOC Punch has a New Editor!
text:
The post of Punch editor has been vacant for a while, since both a Scottish university and a Scottish club enticed our previous editor to move up North. We're grateful that Louise Walker has now stepped into the breach and, now that orienteering is back on the road (and soon, hopefully, back in the forest!) hoping to get the next edition out by the end of August.

Louise has been a club member for a number of years, has chaired the committee, and is a qualified coach. She is highly organised and has already put out a request for articles via the club email list, so we'd better all get typing! Contributions can be sent to Louise at punch@suffoc.co.uk.

We'd like to thank our previous editor, Chloe, for all the work she did in this voluntary post, and wish her every success both on her course and with her new club.
